text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from 104,474 to 91,915 despite no trading, so holding through a decline is not automatically the right choice; I should review whether my allocation still suits my goals.","I should make decisions from a clear plan for diversification and acceptable risk, not from hope that losing positions will recover.","I rarely check my account, so I should schedule occasional reviews and use them to assess my holdings calmly rather than trade impulsively."]}
